name: Kanou Atsu
source:
Atsu, married to [url=https://vndb.org/c77256]Seiji[/url], 20 years later. She is now a mother of a [url=https://vndb.org/c77260]big girl[/url] and a [url=https://vndb.org/c77261]little boy[/url].

She and Seiji decide to show to their children the place where they started their love story.
